agent_summary: Client-side lane on juice.lab.test (OWASP Juice Shop, Angular SPA, plain HTTP, nginx). 60 read-only requests sent; no writes. Reviewed the app shell/index.html, the main/polyfills/scripts/styles bundles and ~10 readable lazy ESM chunks, plus the REST/API surface. Findings by item: - CLNT-01/02 (DOM XSS / JS execution) — LEFT OPEN: cannot be executed/confirmed with read-only HTTP (needs a browser). Established the preconditions and recorded a HIGH lead: no CSP at all (index.html even inlines a script; no CSP header on app shell or API — x13/x1), the search endpoint does not reflect server-side so any search XSS is DOM-based (x6), readable chunks contain Angular [innerHTML]/[src] bindings using sanitizer-bypass markers (gallery/about chunk x23), and the JWT is stored in localStorage and decoded client-side (hacking-instructor chunk x20), so any script execution = token/account takeover. A reviewer with a browser should confirm /#/search?q=

leads.title: [agent] DOM-based XSS conditions present: no CSP, Angular innerHTML sanitizer-bypass sinks, JWT in localStorage

detail.text: The app ships no Content-Security-Policy (index.html head has no CSP meta; no CSP response header on app shell/API — exchanges x13, x1) and even inlines a <script> in index.html. The server search endpoint /rest/products/search?q= does not reflect the query server-side (returns {"status":"success","data":[]} for an HTML payload — x6), so any search XSS is DOM-based in the Angular client. Readable lazy chunks show Angular property bindings that bypass sanitization, e.g. the gallery component uses [innerHTML] with the bypassSecurityTrustHtml marker and [src] with a resource-URL bypass (about.component chunk x23). The session JWT is stored in browser localStorage and decoded client-side (hacking-instructor chunk x20), so any script execution on the origin yields full token/account takeover. Confirming the canonical Juice Shop search DOM-XSS (query rendered via bypassSecurityTrustHtml into [innerHTML]) requires a browser to execute; the minified 1.2MB main.js could not be grepped over read-only HTTP. A reviewer with a browser should load /#/search?q=<iframe src="javascript:alert(1)"> and confirm execution.

[agent] GET http://juice.lab.test/ -> 200. All responses (app shell at /, assets) carry X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, which blocks framing from other origins. Clickjacking from a third-party origin is mitigated by XFO:SAMEORIGIN.
